text.en:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengangkutan Jalan

(Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Jalan Persekutuan) (No. 15) (Pembatalan) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 April 2022.

Pembatalan

2. Perintah Pengangkutan Jalan (Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Jalan Persekutuan)

(No. 15) 2021 [P.U. (A) 449/2021] dibatalkan.

Dibuat 24 Mac 2022

[KKR.100-1/2/79 Jld.2; PN(PU2)460/Jld. 116]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

 Menteri Kanan Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) (NO. 15) (REVOCATION) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 70

of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Senior Minister of Works, after taking into

consideration the matters referred to in subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the

following order:
